doc_class_description: A Sri Lanka Cabinet Decision is an official policy or action agreed by the Cabinet of Ministers, shaping governance, law, and national development in the country.

latest_doc_d.description: Appointment to the Post of Director General of the Department of Technical Education and Training
latest_doc_d.decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-10-12 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
latest_doc_d.decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2026-01-26, to appoint Mrs. Dilki Wathsala Marambage, Grade I Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, to the post of Director General of the Department of Technical Education and Training on full-time acting basis. She has been promoted to the Special Grade of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service by the Public Service Commission, from 2026-01-01. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education, and Vocational Education to appoint Mrs. Dilki Wathsala Marambage to the post of Director General of the Department of Technical Education and Training on permanent basis, was approved by the Cabinet.
